title: NVIDIA & 35 Tech Giants Launch 'Open Secure AI Alliance' for AI Cybersecurity
summary: Develops open-source security tools to detect and respond to AI-powered cyber threats.

blocks.content: Develops open-source security tools to detect and respond to AI-powered cyber threats.

items: Founding Alliance Members: Microsoft, IBM, Cisco, Adobe, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike, HPE, Hugging Face, Red Hat, SpaceX, Linux Foundation.
Notable Absentees: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta are absent from alliance roster.
Foundational Framework: Builds on Linux Foundation's Akrites initiative and OpenSSF.
